fight-grove-entrance.text: Convince Rolan to stay before leaving the grove.
After triggering Investigate the Beach, do not long rest until Mirkon is safe.
Expose Kagha before stealing the idol; stealing it during the ritual can get the tieflings killed.
As Dark Urge, knock out Alfira before the relevant long rest.

fight-blighted-village.text: Use Disguise Self: Drow for the safer village dialogue route.
At the windmill choose the BRAKE lever, not Release Brake, to save Barcus.
Recruit Lump's ogres for an emergency summon instead of spending that resource immediately.

fight-owlbear.text: The encounter can be avoided. If the cub remains hostile after the adults die, flee rather than kill it.

fight-auntie-ethel.text: If you want Auntie Ethel's Hair, leave Ethel alive below roughly 20 HP and let her next turn begin so the bargain triggers.
Use non-lethal damage if you intend to preserve Ethel's controlled victims.

fight-gnolls.text: Speak to Rugan and Olly before combat and use the tadpole option on Flind when available.
Keep the shipment unopened if you want the Zhentarim special stock and Titanstring Bow route.

fight-goblin-leaders.text: Finish grove and camp conversations before making the camp hostile; talk to Abdirak, Volo, Liam, the spiders, and Gut for the brand first if desired.
Take Gut into isolation and Silence her; resolve Minthara deliberately; leave Dror Ragzlin for last.
Do not enter the Mountain Pass after the leaders; finish the remaining surface route first.

fight-underdark-minotaurs.text: Save Thulla and give Derryth the Noblestalk if you want to preserve the Act 3 shop supply.

fight-arcane-tower.text: Read the tower poetry before speaking to Bernard and choose the poetry-derived peaceful responses to avoid the fight and preserve reward options.

fight-nere.text: Visit Philomeen and recruit Brithvar, or clear the duergar, before freeing Nere.
Once you enter Grymforge and trigger the cave-in state, treat Nere's rescue as time-sensitive.

fight-gith-patrol.text: Prefer the dialogue route. Bring Lae'zel, or use Disguise Self: Gith for the safer deception route.
Pass or defeat the patrol, but deliberately defer entering the Mountain Pass until the Act 1 readiness gate is clear.

fight-wargaz.text: Before the zaith'isk dialogue, prepare for Intelligence DC 12, Wisdom DC 15, and Constitution DC 18 checks.
Long rest before the Inquisitor's Chamber and spread the party before dialogue ends.
